# Eduvia Consultancy

> Study-abroad consultancy in Nepal. We guide students through university
> selection, applications, scholarships, test preparation (IELTS/PTE/TOEFL/
> GRE/GMAT/SAT/Duolingo) and student visas for Australia, the UK, the USA,
> Canada, Ireland, Germany, New Zealand and other destinations.

We answer questions about admission requirements, tuition fees, living costs,
scholarships, visa processes and post-study work rights for international
students — with a focus on Nepali students.

All paths below are relative to this site's origin.

## Key pages

- [/study-abroad](/study-abroad): study destinations — country guides with universities, costs and visa info
- [/universities](/universities): programs, fees and admission requirements
- [/blogs](/blogs): guides on studying, working and settling abroad
- [/course-finder](/course-finder): search programs by level, country and field
- [/scholarships](/scholarships): funding options for international students
- [/test-preparation](/test-preparation): IELTS, PTE, TOEFL, GRE, GMAT, SAT, Duolingo
- [/student-visa](/student-visa): per-country visa requirements and checklists
- [/success-stories](/success-stories): results from students we have guided
- [/contact](/contact): office locations and inquiry form

## Organizational signals

- Publisher: Eduvia Consultancy Pvt. Ltd. (Nepal)
- Audience: students from Nepal and South Asia planning to study abroad
- Primary languages: English, Nepali
- Freshness: destination guides and blog posts are updated regularly from the
  editorial CMS; timestamps are exposed on blog articles (datePublished /
  dateModified in JSON-LD).
